name: grimmsnarl_ml_v24
policy: Frozen v22 policy plus an unconditional veto of a selected Froslass evolution after the opponent has publicly revealed the Grimmsnarl line.

policy_escalation.effective_runtime: Inherited from v22; the global teacher pin is already code 0, so it causes no separate teacher switch.

mirror_froslass_guard.matchup_detection: Opponent Active, Bench, discard, and public pre-evolutions only; no hand, deck, or prize information.
mirror_froslass_guard.trigger: The effective v22 choice after its inherited planner is a Froslass evolution in a publicly visible mirror.
mirror_froslass_guard.action: Veto every Froslass evolution option and take v22's highest-scored remaining option.
mirror_froslass_guard.scope_limit: Does not suppress Snorunt setup or Froslass searches; evolution is the measured lever and v22 is otherwise frozen.

legacy_broad_froslass_action_proxy.definition_correction: The inherited froslass_evolves CSV column counts selected Froslass card actions other than attack, ability, end and retreat; it includes searches and evolution-resolution prompts, not only true evolutions.

corrected_true_froslass_evolution.multiplicity_status: Does not survive a fresh 20-lever Bonferroni correction; v24 is a causal ladder experiment, not a promoted fix.
corrected_true_froslass_evolution.replication_limit: Direction is adverse in v22_a, v22_b and v22_c but reversed in the two v22_d games; the all-four replication claim belongs only to the legacy broad proxy.

non_mirror_placebo.interpretation: No general Froslass penalty outside the mirror.

rejected_gate.reason: The ledger analysis was computed on the same legacy broad card-action events and points backwards even there; v24 therefore does not use shroud_net.

historical_opponent_asymmetry_resolution.old_measurement: The 12/12 uptake came from 36 v15 mirrors and measured offered-turn imitation, not a causal win contrast for v22.
historical_opponent_asymmetry_resolution.interpretation: In the current pool, opposing winners evolve less than our losing seat; the old 12/12 observation does not reverse the v24 direction.

submission_package.extracted_import_smoke: PASS: ranker and mirror guard loaded; no load errors

known_limits: The corrected true-evolution association is observational and weaker than the original mislabeled broad proxy; ladder A/B is required for a causal promotion decision.
Teacher forcing measures binding and preservation on stored boards, not the downstream states created after an override.
The visible-mirror detector cannot act before the opponent publicly reveals Impidimp, Morgrem, or Grimmsnarl ex.
description: V22 champion policy with one mirror-only, measured Froslass-evolution suppression experiment.
